description: This file defines the MenuNode class for the YAHOO.widget namespace, extending TextNode, used for representing menu items in a tree view.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.MenuNode
classes.description: A class representing a menu node within a hierarchical tree, extending TextNode with additional properties for menu behavior.

methods.description: Initializes a MenuNode instance, setting up data, parent, expansion state, and label.

methods.description: Sets up the MenuNode with data, parent node, and expanded state.

methods.description: Configures the label for the menu node based on provided data.
